title: Français 5160
contents: Savoy’s policy toward Spain and the proposed marriage of the Infanta; the Duke of Mantua, Casale and the Monferrat dispute. Brienne also reports army news, the fall of Bordeaux and the succession to La Vieuville in financial administration.
fields: 10 January and 1 August 1653; letter B undated in selected cipher pages
136 symbols/codes: 25 letter signs, 101 in nomenclature, 7 nulls ?, 3 unidentified
Plaintext in another folio of the same volume
Same volume: literal plaintext of letter B at f10r; literal plaintext of letter C at ff17r–v. Letter A uses the same key. ·

excerpt: Les sages en jugent autrement je m’en remettray à leurs sentimens. Pour avoir droit de se plaindre **du duc de Mantoue des graces qu'il depart aux Espagnols**, il faudroit l'en rechercher **de semblables** ou de **quipolentes**, et sy il s'y rendoit difficile on pouroit avec justice luy reprocher sa conduitte. Mais de luy imputer…
translation: The wise judge otherwise; I will defer to their judgment. To complain about the Duke of Mantua’s favors to the Spaniards, one would have to ask him for similar or equivalent favors; if he proved reluctant, one could then justly reproach his conduct. But to impute to him…
